AppDetails.Author: Bryan D Esser
AppDetails.Description: Features include: round, annular, segmented, center-of-mass, and virtual aperture detectors. Images can be formed very rapidly for quickly analyzing 4DSTEM datasets. Data can be loaded into physical memory, or as a memory-mapped file for systems with limited memory, or especially large datasets.
AppDetails.Name: Quant4D
AppDetails.Summary: This app is designed to allow for rapid manipulation of large experimental or simulated 4DSTEM datasets.
